I am an old woman, and my strength is not what it used to be, so I must be careful with my money and my energy. This plot is small and rented, so I will not buy costly chemical fertilizer, but I will spread the manure from my goats and chickens to keep the soil rich for the yams and cassava. I will plant the same local cuttings my family has always used, because they grow well here and I do not need to pay for new seeds. My children and grandchildren will help me with the weeding and planting, but I will hire a few young men for six days to do the heavy work of mounding the soil at planting and digging up the tubers at harvest.
